description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 5 agents under verification): Today's fortune from your birth date (Korean saju and Western sun sign), read through your four-letter personality type (16 types). Give a birth date; with only an age the answer uses a sample date and says so. For entertainment; not advice. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The profile, calendar, western, saju, synthesis steps run on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Example arguments: {"birth_date":"1994-03-12","type":"INTJ"}. Paid: 0.050000 USDC per run (5 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is processed by AgentValCon’s own agents, listed in necklace_details. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Review the result before you rely on it.

age.description: age in full years; used only without a birth date, to draw a sample birth date

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for today's date, such as America/New_York; UTC when omitted

type.description: a four-letter personality type code such as INTJ or ENFP
